authoring_units: BU; normalized controls; not game timings

power.description: Electrical availability; independent from retained heat/fill

heat.description: Retained normalized heat; independent from power

deployment.description: 0 closed, 1 open; reversible at any point

hinge_design: Two wings per former fin; Y hinges at x +/-0.18 and z +0.32 from former blade socket. Wings fold upward into separate vertical slots.
phase_policy: cycle_turns is integrated phase, not speed. Stop retains phase. NLA cycle repetition must use cyclic extrapolation/REPEAT_OFFSET for spin; never reset turns on start. Clips start from relative phase 0; apply current phase offset when sequencing.
